methodology.title: منهجية استخراج مواضيع الكتابة (Writing Topics)
methodology.description: يتم استخراج مواضيع الكتابة من نهاية كل درس في كتاب الطالب وكتاب النشاط.

topics.title: Write a paragraph about a school club event you organized.
guiding_questions: What is the name of your club and what do people do there?
What event did you organize and why was it important?
What happened on the day of the event? (Include two good things and one problem)
topics.sample_essay: I am a member of the Science Club at my school. We organized a camping trip to learn about nature. It was important because we learned new things about plants and animals. On the day, we went hiking and had a barbecue. We also made new friends. However, the weather was rainy, but we still had a great time.

topics.title: Write a paragraph about a special day in your life that you'll never forget.
guiding_questions: Why will you never forget it?
topics.sample_essay: My special day was my birthday last year. My family and friends came to celebrate with me. We ate delicious food and played games together. My father gave me a new phone, and my mother made a beautiful cake. I will never forget this day because I felt very happy and loved.
